headline: Insurance claims over "rogue" AI are expected to test the liability of OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman and Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei, the Financial Times reports.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1: only the Financial Times headline could be read and no other outlet carries the story, so it is unverified.
importance_line: Whether the heads of two leading AI labs can be held liable matters to anyone harmed by "rogue" AI and to the insurers asked to pay, but the claims, the sums and the legal route are not known from the headline alone.
summary: The Financial Times reports that insurance claims are set to test the liability of Sam Altman, chief executive of OpenAI, and Dario Amodei, chief executive of Anthropic, for "rogue" AI.
notes: Headline only: the FT page returns 403 and no other outlet carries the story (six Google News searches).
